name: mirage
text: Fair. For the record, the new build has been up only 3 minutes and is still on its first cold scan (4,669 priced lines, versus ~16,000 once warm), so these numbers aren't the fixed ones yet: 64% still 'no fair line'. What I can already see from the journals: about two thirds of the legs with no fair are player props (touchdowns, receiving/rushing yards, NBA points) and the rest are NFL/college game lines that the old index dropped between scan passes (now fixed). I'll measure at 10 minutes warm and attack whichever class is biggest, props first.
